svg.title: URTC-DEVTOOLS architecture
svg.desc: URTC-DEVTOOLS holds the canonical copy of the eighteen files that every repository of the family carries as the same file (the documentation-policy and README-parity checks, the picture generators, the live panel of the build scripts, the manifest version bumper, the status-light check and the dashboard notice). The version of this repository is the version of the set. URTC-DOCS puts the files into a repository and writes tools/devtools.lock.json with that version and the SHA-256 of every copy, so an edited copy and a copy that fell behind are both found. Everything is tested on a computer; every repository of the family carries the lock.

svg.text: The shared repository tools of the URTC family as one set with a version and a lock.
